description.en: Ireland is an Atlantic island country located in Western Europe, occupying the vast majority of the island of Ireland and sharing a land border to the east with Northern Ireland, which is part of the United Kingdom. Renowned for its lush, endless green landscapes, thriving high-tech and pharmaceutical sectors, and deep Celtic cultural heritage, Ireland stands as a premier European hub for global corporate headquarters and foreign direct investment.
description.zh: Ireland是位於西歐的大西洋島國，佔據愛爾蘭島的大部分地區，東側與英國（United Kingdom）的北愛爾蘭接壤。該國以綠色自然景觀、資訊科技產業與深厚的凱爾特文化聞名，是歐洲重要的高科技與外資投資中心之一。

seoText.en: Explore quick facts about Ireland — population, land area, capital city, and a short overview. Learn about Dublin Silicon Docks tech, Cliffs of Moher landscapes, St. Patrick's Day celebration, Celtic music, and Irish pub craic culture.
seoText.zh: 快速了解愛爾蘭的基本資料：人口、面積、首都與簡短概述。探索都柏林矽谷碼頭、莫赫懸崖巨浪、聖派翠克節盛典、凱爾特傳統音樂以及愛爾蘭酒吧社交文化。

list: Sovereign Atlantic island nation situated in Western Europe
Occupies the sovereign southern and western portions of the island of Ireland
Bordered to the northeast by Northern Ireland, part of the United Kingdom
Pivotal European Union technological, pharmaceutical, and financial hub
en.text:
Famously referred to as the 'Emerald Isle' due to its spectacular green pastures, Ireland is a land where ancient Celtic myth blends with high-tech modernity.

As a highly advanced developed economy, the country has become the preferred European headquarters for major global tech companies like Google, Apple, and Meta. Governed as a parliamentary republic, Ireland champions European integration, multilingual culture, and global trade.

list: 位於西歐的島國
佔據愛爾蘭島大部分地區
與英國北愛爾蘭接壤
歐盟重要科技與金融據點
zh.text:
愛爾蘭（Ireland）是位於西歐的大西洋島國，佔據愛爾蘭島的大部分地區，東側與英國（United Kingdom）的北愛爾蘭接壤。該國以綠色自然景觀、資訊科技產業與深厚的凱爾特文化聞名，是歐洲重要的高科技與外資投資中心之一。

愛爾蘭首都為都柏林（Dublin），是國家政治、經濟與文化中心，因政府提供極具競爭力的企業稅率，現已成為眾多全球科技與製藥巨擘在歐洲的首選總部所在地。身為穩定的議會共和國，愛爾蘭積極推動歐盟一體化、多元語言文化並高度融入全球貿易體系。

list: Island geography dominated by low central plains and coastal hills
Ruggedly beautiful and dramatic western coastlines
Abundant lakes, flowing rivers, and lush green pastures
Lacks major high-altitude mountain chains, offering rolling hills
en.text:
Spanning 70,273 square kilometers, Ireland's geography is famously lush, earning the name 'Emerald Isle' because its frequent rains sustain deep green fields.

The rugged western coast boasts world-class sights like the towering Cliffs of Moher, rising vertically out of the Atlantic. The interior features flat central lowlands drained by the Shannon River and dotted with serene lakes.

list: 島嶼國家，地形以平原與丘陵為主
西岸海岸線崎嶇壯麗
湖泊與綠地密布
無大型山脈系統
zh.text: 愛爾蘭（Ireland）地形整體較為平緩，被稱為「翡翠島」，因為充足的降雨與連綿的草地，使全國呈現濃郁蔥鬱的綠色景觀。崎嶇的西部海岸擁有著名懸崖地形，如拔地而起的莫赫懸崖（Cliffs of Moher）一帶，是極為重要的觀光資源；內陸則以平坦的中央低地、香農河（Shannon River）流域以及星羅棋布的寧靜湖泊為特徵。

list: Temperate maritime climate moderated by the North Atlantic Drift
Extremely mild and humid conditions throughout all seasons
Winters are gentle with rare instances of severe freezing
Frequent, soft rainfall maintaining year-round vibrant greenery
en.text:
Ireland has a mild temperate maritime climate, heavily warmed by the North Atlantic Drift. Winters are gentle, and summers are cool with rare heatwaves.

Frequent, light showers are typical, keeping the landscape extraordinarily green. Weather patterns change rapidly, making it common to experience sun, wind, and rain on the same afternoon.

list: 溫帶海洋性氣候
全年溫和濕潤
冬季不嚴寒
降雨頻繁
zh.text: 愛爾蘭受北大西洋暖流影響，屬於溫帶海洋性氣候，氣候溫和穩定，全年溫差不大，冬季極少嚴寒，夏季亦相當涼爽。由於頻繁的細雨降水，使植被長年保持翠綠。天氣變化快速是其典型特徵之一，在同一個下午經歷晴天、大風與陣雨是當地人的生活常態。

list: Steadily growing population of approximately 5.2 million residents
High concentration of residents situated in eastern coastal cities
Highly urbanized demographic profile centered around the capital
Increasing multicultural diversity fueled by European migration
en.text:
Ireland's population has rebounded to 5.2 million, heavily concentrated in the Greater Dublin Area.

Due to the EU's open borders and the country's economic boom, Ireland has welcomed a growing number of international professionals, enriching the cultural fabric. English is spoken everywhere, while Irish Gaelic is a preserved official language taught in schools.

list: 人口約 520萬左右
人口集中於東部城市
城市化程度高
移民人口持續增加
zh.text: 愛爾蘭（Ireland）人口目前已回升至520萬左右，主要集中於東部的大都柏林地區（Greater Dublin Area），該地區集中了全國大部分的經濟與科技活動。近年受惠於歐盟人口自由流動政策與高科技產業的繁榮，吸引了大量海外專業人才移居，使社會結構更趨多元。英語為全國普及的商業與生活語言，而傳統的愛爾蘭蓋爾語（Irish Gaelic）作為官方語言亦在學校教育中受到妥善保護。

list: Highly developed, export-oriented economic powerhouse
Global leader in technology, internet, and biopharma hubs
Preferred European Union headquarters location for tech conglomerates
Low corporate tax framework attracting massive global capital
en.text:
Ireland's economy is highly modern and export-driven. A business-friendly environment and a competitive corporate tax rate have made Dublin's 'Silicon Docks' the European home for giants like Google, Meta, Apple, and Pfizer.

This makes the nation a global leader in software exports, financial services, and advanced pharmaceuticals, though it remains sensitive to shifts in global corporate policy.

list: 高度發達的出口導向經濟
科技與製藥產業強勢
跨國企業歐洲總部集中地
低企業稅政策吸引外資
zh.text: 愛爾蘭是歐洲極其重要的科技、網路與生物製藥產業基地，憑藉親商環境與具競爭力的低企業稅政策，讓都柏林（Dublin）的「矽谷碼頭」（Silicon Docks）雲集了 Google、Apple、Meta 與 Pfizer 等跨國巨擘的歐洲總部。這使該國在軟體出口、國際金融服務與先進醫藥領域高居全球領先地位，但其經濟發展也對全球企業稅制政策的變動相對敏感。

list: Parliamentary representative democratic republic governance system
President serves as the ceremonial and symbolic head of state
Prime Minister (Taoiseach) directs the executive administration
Highly committed member nation of the European Union bloc
en.text:
Ireland is a stable parliamentary republic. The President acts as the ceremonial head of state, while executive power is exercised by the Prime Minister, historically known as the Taoiseach, and the Cabinet.

The bicameral parliament (Oireachtas) passes national laws. Ireland's EU membership remains a core pillar of its geopolitical and trade policies.

list: 議會制共和國
總統為象徵性元首
總理負責實際行政
歐盟成員國
zh.text: 愛爾蘭（Ireland）為政局穩定的議會制民主共和國，總統為國家元首兼精神象徵，實際行政權力由總理（愛爾蘭語稱為 Taoiseach）與政府內閣行使。兩院制國會（Oireachtas）負責制定法律。作為歐盟（European Union）成員國，加入歐洲單一市場與歐元區是其地緣政治與貿易政策的核心支柱。

list: Consistently enjoys exceptionally high standards of living and safety
World-class public education and robust medical systems
English functions as the primary spoken and commercial language
Highly progressive, open, and welcoming social environment
en.text:
Irish society is warm, friendly, and progressive, characterized by a famous sense of community and humor. Education standards are exceptionally high, producing a highly skilled, young workforce.

Over the past few decades, social reforms have transformed the country into an open, inclusive, and modern society that attracts talent from around the world.

list: 生活品質高
教育與醫療體系完善
英語為主要語言
社會相對開放包容
zh.text: 愛爾蘭社會以卓越的生活品質、高治安水準與頂尖的教育制度著稱。英語為主要語言，同時愛爾蘭語（Gaelic）也是官方語言。愛爾蘭人以幽默、熱情和注重社區凝聚力聞名，過去數十年來的社會體制改革更使其蛻變為進步、包容且高度開放的現代化社會，持續吸引各國高素質人才湧入。

list: Deep-seated Celtic customs forming the national cultural core
Vibrant heritage in traditional music, folk dance, and literature
Famous pub and socializing culture celebrated across the globe
St. Patrick's Day serves as a major international identity link
en.text:
Ireland has produced global giants in literature, from James Joyce and Oscar Wilde to W.B. Yeats. Traditional Irish music, played on fiddles and bodhráns, fills pubs in every town.

The Irish pub is a central social hub, fostering the legendary concept of *craic* (good conversation and fun). St. Patrick's Day is celebrated worldwide, serving as a vibrant symbol of Irish identity.

list: 凱爾特文化傳統深厚
音樂與文學影響全球
酒吧文化與社交文化盛行
聖派翠克節為重要節日
zh.text: 愛爾蘭文化以凱爾特傳統為核心，在文學方面誕生了詹姆斯·喬伊斯（James Joyce）、奧斯卡·王爾德（Oscar Wilde）與葉慈（W.B. Yeats）等世界級巨匠。傳統愛爾蘭音樂（如小提琴與愛爾蘭山羊鼓）悠揚於各小鎮客棧。歷史悠久的愛爾蘭酒吧是核心的社交樞紐，孕育出獨特的「Craic」（意指歡樂交談與趣味）文化。每年三月的聖派翠克節（St. Patrick’s Day）更是全球知名的慶典，強烈連結著海外愛爾蘭社群的認同。

list: Severe metropolitan housing shortages and soaring rental costs
High economic dependency on foreign direct investment policies
Addressing immigration growth and public infrastructure stress
Pioneering green energy transitions and carbon reduction plans
en.text:
Ireland's rapid economic growth has led to a severe housing shortage in Dublin, causing high property prices and rental costs. The economy's dependence on foreign tech giants leaves it exposed to shifts in global corporation rules.

Environmental planners are working to scale offshore wind power in the Atlantic to meet ambitious green energy goals.

list: 房價與住房短缺
科技產業依賴外資
移民與人口壓力
氣候政策與能源轉型
zh.text: 愛爾蘭近年因經濟與人口快速增長，面臨嚴峻的住房短缺與租金飆升問題，特別是在都柏林（Dublin）都會區。同時，經濟高度依賴跨國科技與製藥巨擘的外資直接投資，也使其容易受到全球跨國稅制變更的風險影響。目前政府正致力於發展大西洋離岸風力發電，以達成雄心勃勃的綠色能源轉型與減碳目標。

list: Dublin — Historic capital famous for Temple Bar and Trinity College
Cork — Progressive harbor city known for food markets and trade
Galway — Artistic cultural capital boasting vibrant music streets
Cliffs of Moher — Towering ocean precipices offering panoramic views
en.text:
Dublin features elegant Georgian squares, the historic Trinity College library, and Temple Bar. Cork is a proud culinary and trading port city along the River Lee.

Galway is the artistic heartland, famous for colorful busking streets and bohemian shops. The spectacular Cliffs of Moher run for 14 kilometers, rising 214 meters high above the crashing Atlantic waves.

list: Dublin —— 首都與科技中心
Cork —— 第二大城市與港口
Galway —— 文化與藝術城市
Cliffs of Moher —— 著名自然景觀
zh.text: 首都都柏林（Dublin）擁有優雅的喬治亞風格廣場、歷史悠久的聖三一學院（Trinity College）老圖書館以及熱鬧的聖殿酒吧區（Temple Bar）。科克（Cork）是位於李河畔、引以為傲的飲食與貿易港口大城。高威（Galway）則被譽為文化與藝術之都，以五彩繽紛的街頭藝術、現場音樂與波西米亞風商店聞名。而壯麗的莫赫懸崖（Cliffs of Moher）橫跨14公里，高達214公尺，直面大西洋的驚濤駭浪，提供震撼人心的全景視野。

list: Core member state of the European Union and Eurozone integration
Shares close economic, historical, and demographic bonds with the UK
Global diplomatic actor favoring international multilateral treaties
Maintains strong political and economic connections to the USA
en.text:
As an EU member, Ireland is a strong advocate for European integration. While historical ties with the UK are deep and complex, today they are defined by close commercial trade.

Due to its large diaspora, Ireland has exceptionally strong political and cultural ties with the United States, positioning it as a key bridge between North America and Europe.

list: 歐盟核心成員國
與英國關係密切且複雜
全球科技與金融連結強
外交政策偏向多邊合作
zh.text: 愛爾蘭（Ireland）作為歐盟（European Union）成員國，在國際事務上堅定支持歐洲一體化。與英國（United Kingdom）的歷史關係深厚且複雜，但現今雙方以高度緊密的商業與經貿合作為主。此外，由於歷史上大量移民海外形成的龐大僑民網絡，愛爾蘭與美國維持著極其牢固的政治、經濟與文化紐帶，使其成為連結北美與歐洲的重要橋樑。

list: Steady trade, focusing on electronic chips and pharmaceutical inputs
Growing higher education partnerships and academic research
Active commercial representation offices in both capital cities
Collaborative hubs for tech start-ups and digital commerce
en.text:
Taiwan and Ireland enjoy a productive trade relationship centered on tech and pharma, exchanging key electronics components and advanced medical ingredients.

Educational ties are growing, with Taiwanese students choosing Ireland for English studies. Trade representation offices in Dublin and Taipei facilitate active business networking, tech partnerships, and cultural exchanges.

list: 經緯交流穩定
科技與教育合作逐步增加
民間往來有限但友好
歐洲市場間接合作窗口
zh.text: 愛爾蘭與台灣之間維持穩定的非官方雙邊關係。雙方在經貿合作上以高科技與製藥產業為核心，互換關鍵電子零組件與先進醫藥原料。教育交流亦逐步增長，越來越多台灣學生選擇前往愛爾蘭進修英語或修讀高等學位。設於都柏林與台北的貿易代表處有效促進了彼此在科技新創、數位商務與文化活動上的互動。

list: Affectionately known across the world as the vibrant 'Emerald Isle'
The European headquarters hub for premier global tech enterprises
Rich literary and traditional music heritage that shapes global culture
A small island state operating a highly globalized developed economy
被稱為「翡翠島」
歐洲科技公司重要據點
文學與音樂文化影響深遠
人口小但經濟高度國際化

text.en: Irish Tricolour Flag — The vertical green, white, and orange bands representing peace and hope between the green Catholic and orange Protestant factions
text.zh: 愛爾蘭三色國旗——垂直排列的綠、白、橙三色旗，綠色象徵多數天主教社群，橙色代表新教教派，白條象徵兩者間永久和平與團結的希望

text.en: Shamrock & Folklore — The sacred three-leafed Shamrock clover, historical Celtic legends of Leprechauns, and traditional storytelling
text.zh: 酢漿草與凱爾特傳說——聖博德（St. Patrick）宣教時採用的三葉「酢漿草」化為國家至高無上的精神圖騰，伴隨著愛爾蘭小精靈與古老傳奇

text.en: Cliffs of Moher — The spectacular 214-meter jagged sea cliffs dropping vertically into the raging Atlantic Ocean, hosting vast puffin collections
text.zh: 莫赫懸崖（Cliffs of Moher）——綿延 14 公里、高達 214 公尺的崎嶇黑色頁岩懸崖，直面大西洋的驚濤駭浪，為歐洲最壯麗且極具震撼的海岸絕景

text.en: Silicon Docks Power — The high-tech Dublin bay district serving as the European Union corporate headquarters hub for major tech conglomerates
text.zh: 都柏林矽谷碼頭——都柏林運河碼頭區被譽為歐洲的「矽谷碼頭」（Silicon Docks），雲集 Google、Apple、Meta 等跨國巨擘的歐盟總部

text.en: Craic & Pub Sessions — Vibrant traditional Celtic music played live on fiddles and bodhráns inside Dublin's traditional historic pubs
text.zh: 傳統酒吧與精神 (Craic)——愛爾蘭傳統小鎮酒館內夜夜彈奏的小提琴、愛爾蘭風笛與踢踏舞，體現出愛爾蘭人極致歡樂與熱情社交的靈魂
